index.description: The index (a collection on Typesense). search_list_indexes lists them.

documents.description: The documents to write, each with its id field (objectID, the primary key, id, the key). A person approves the exact documents.

mode.description: replace: a document with an existing id replaces it whole. merge: its fields are merged into the existing document, which is created when missing.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
